violation_type.title: The primary caregiver lives in the home where care is provided. (26 TAC §747.201(a)(1))
violation_type.short_title: The primary caregiver lives in the home where care is provided.
violation_type.typical_finding: The primary caregiver stated that she resides in the daycare home Monday through Friday and stays at her personal residence, located at a different address, on weekends.

finding_variants.text: The primary caregiver stated that she resides in the daycare home Monday through Friday and stays at her personal residence, located at a different address, on weekends.

A household member indicated that the primary caregiver does not reside in the home where care is given. The primary caregiver's driver's license confirms that he is not living in the residence where care is provided.
It was confirmed during the inspection that the provider does not live in the registered home where the children are being cared for.
It was confirmed during the inspection that the provider does not live in the Licensed Child-Care Home where the children are being cared for.
During the inspection, Ms. Allen's sister shared with me that she and her sister are not living in this home. They are living at different addresses.
The primary caregiver does not live in the home
